landing.heroDescription: Clann is a private family tree app. Record people, build relationships, and explore your ancestry through an interactive visual graph — all stored on your own server.
landing.ctaText: Ready to start mapping your family?

tree.title: Interactive Family Tree
tree.description: Visualise up to two generations of ancestors, plus children and spouses, in a colour-coded graph. Toggle between vertical and horizontal layouts, pan, zoom, and click any node to navigate.

relationships.title: Relationships
relationships.description: Link people as Father, Mother, Sibling, or Spouse. Adding a sibling automatically inherits the parent's parents. Spouse relationships carry optional from/to dates.

photos.title: Photos
photos.description: Upload a JPEG or PNG photo (up to 3 MB) for each person. Photos appear on profile cards, detail pages, and directly in the family tree graph.

export.title: Export
export.description: Download the family tree as a JPEG image to share with family, or as a structured JSON file for archiving or importing into other tools.

help.title: Help & Documentation
help.subtitle: Learn how to use Clann to build and explore your family tree.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.step1Body: Click Sign In and choose Create Account. Enter a username, email address, and password (at least 8 characters). You will receive a confirmation email — click the link to activate your account.
gettingStarted.step2Body: Click Add Person in the navigation bar. Fill in the first name, family name, and sex (required). Optionally add birth and death dates and places, a biography, and a photo.
gettingStarted.step3Body: Open a person's profile and go to the Relationships tab. Click + Add Relationship to link them as Father, Mother, Sibling, or Spouse of another person in your tree.

people.title: Managing People
people.fieldsBody: Each person has: First Name and Family Name (required), Middle Name, Sex (required), Date and Place of Birth, Date and Place of Death, Nickname, Username, Email, Identity Verified flag, and a Biography (up to 1,000 characters).
people.photoBody: On a person's detail page, click the avatar to open the photo uploader. Drag and drop a JPEG or PNG file (up to 3 MB), or click to browse. Photos appear on cards, detail pages, and in the family tree graph.
people.editBody: Open a person's profile and click Edit to update their details. To delete, click Delete on the profile page or the trash icon on a family member card. Deletion cannot be undone.

relationships.title: Relationships
relationships.typesBody: You can link people as Father, Mother, Sibling (Brother or Sister), or Spouse. Open a person's profile, go to the Relationships tab, and click + Add Relationship to choose the type and the related person.
relationships.siblingBody: When you add a sibling, Clann automatically assigns the same Father and Mother to the new sibling — so you only need to record parents once and all siblings inherit them.
relationships.spouseBody: Spouse relationships can carry optional From and To dates (free-form text, e.g. "1990" or "2 June 2001"). Set them when adding the relationship, or edit them inline in the Relationships tab.

familyTree.title: Family Tree
familyTree.overviewBody: The tree shows the selected person (root) at the centre, up to two generations of ancestors above, direct children below, and spouses to the side. Click any person's name in the family list to open their tree.
familyTree.coloursBody: Emerald = you (root) · Blue = Father side · Rose = Mother side · Amber = Children · Violet = Spouse · Teal = Sibling. The legend is shown at the bottom of the tree.
familyTree.navigationBody: Pan by clicking and dragging. Zoom with the scroll wheel or pinch gesture. Click any node to open that person's profile. Hover over a node to see a tooltip with date of birth, place of birth, and biography.
familyTree.orientationBody: Use the Vertical / Horizontal buttons in the tree toolbar to toggle the layout. Vertical places ancestors above and children below. Horizontal places ancestors to the right and children to the left.
familyTree.exportBody: Click Export as JPEG to download the visible tree as an image you can share. Click Export as JSON to download the raw tree data for archiving or use in other tools.

familyList.title: Family Members List
familyList.viewsBody: Switch between a responsive card grid and a sortable table using the Cards / List toggle at the top of the Family Members page. The card view shows photos; the list view is better for sorting.
familyList.searchBody: Type in the search box to filter by name instantly. In list view, click any column header (Family Name, Date of Birth, Place of Birth) to sort. Empty values always sort to the bottom.
familyList.paginationBody: Use the Per page selector (5, 10, 15, 20, 25, or 30) to control how many people appear at once. Navigate with the numbered page buttons or Prev / Next. The page resets to 1 whenever you search or change the page size.
